CLINICAL FEATURES OF MYIASIS
Clinical Features
- Furuncular myiasis looks like a furuncle (boil)
- Key feature is the presence of a tiny hole in the inflamed erythematous
papule
- There may be a sensation of motion within the furuncle
- There may be intermittent stinging sensation
- In accidental myiasis, there is a pre-existing lesion, usually a leg ulcer,
wound or ulcerated basal cell carcinoma
